comments.value: @{5a4b034d1ab4366d42644996|full_name}: Never understood what those where but everyone seems to want them. What do nested prefab's do?

@{5ae14b192f26cf1a6d66ba79|full_name}: they allow you to embed prefabs in other prefabs.

Suppose you have a chess board set up. You individually prefab every piece with a pickup and a rigidbody, etc. Then you prefab the whole chess board.

But since nested prefabs don't exist yet, the chess board prefab is now one whole. If you change an individual chess piece prefab, these changes are *not* reflected in the whole set up chessboard prefab!

The first Unity 2018 LTS release is now officially available! https://unity3d.com/unity/qa/lts-releases?version=2018.4

In an earlier Canny post, it was mentioned that upgrading to the 2018 LTS would be a priority: https://vrchat.canny.io/feature-requests/p/update-to-unity-2018-lts

I think upgrading the game to Unity 2018 would bring a lot of new possibilities to the table, such as the Jobs system, Progressive lightmapper on the GPU, cloth performance fixes, and much more. Please look into upgrading.
